name: camera-teaser
about: A 20 s product teaser told by the camera on a near-black stage: every shot is one layout under one camera path (lib/camera camPath), the moves chained with no hold. The request box rising, a whip with one flash frame, its close-up and the send button launching, the app window streaming code under a zoom-out whip and a 3D push, cards landing and fanning, the page it made with a modal toast, the product's stages rolling in corner brackets, two comets meeting on the end mark. new-film.sh --template camera-teaser lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every teaser is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): its hits carry the whips and the act lines, designed whooshes ride the camera; never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 110-130 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track); 110-130 BPM, dark and driving, with hits to cut on
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --template camera-teaser --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end stop|button|ring
